summary: The Matrix entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Enter the Matrix
entries.definitive_edition: Original Windows PC release with compatibility fixes documented

emulation.notes: Use native PC compatibility fixes; console emulation only for version comparison.

primary.version: Original PC release with compatibility fixes
primary.why: Enter the Matrix was released across PC and sixth-generation consoles with live-action film footage integrated into the game. PC is the cleanest capture route if an owned copy can be run with compatibility fixes, while console versions are useful for controller/performance comparison.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned Windows PC copy with compatibility fixes. Record OS, patch/fix state, resolution, controller, character route, difficulty, hacking minigame/progress, FMV playback quality, and whether PS2/GameCube/Xbox versions were compared.

secondary.why: PC is the capture route, but original console versions were prominent releases.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record FMV playback quality and character route; do not merge with The Matrix: Path of Neo or The Matrix Online.
